steps.title: Unbox & Charge
steps.desc: Remove the dispenser from packaging. Charge fully before first use (USB-C, approx. 3 hours). LED turns green when fully charged.

steps.title: Fill Chambers
steps.desc: Open the dispenser (twist cap on top). Fill the three chambers with your chosen products: soap, shaving foam, toothpaste. Use the included refill bottles for clean transfer.

steps.title: Choose Mounting
steps.desc:
Option A (Adhesive): Clean wall surface (tiles, glass, mirror) with alcohol. Remove 3M pad backing and press dispenser firmly for 30 sec.

Option B (Screws): Mark drill holes using template. Drill 6 mm holes, insert anchors, screw bracket securely.

steps.title: Set Dosage
steps.desc: Press the mode button on the side to cycle through the three chambers (LED indicates active mode). Hold 3 sec. to change dose level (1–3 blinks = level 1–3).

steps.title: Ready to Use!
steps.desc: Hold your hand, toothbrush, or shaving brush under the desired outlet. Sensor detects proximity and dispenses the set amount. Refill: When LED blinks red, open refill pack and fill chamber.

tips.title: Tip 1
tips.desc: For shaving foam: Pump 2–3 times before first use until foam appears.

tips.title: Tip 2
tips.desc: Choose standard toothpaste consistency (regular tubes work perfectly).

tips.title: Tip 3
tips.desc: Clean outlets weekly with warm water to prevent limescale.

tips.title: Tip 4
tips.desc: For extended non-use: Turn off dispenser (hold mode button 3 sec.).
